verdict.rationale: Rive is a collaborative design and animation editor, so in-file commenting, @mentions and resolvable threads are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents only adjacent collaboration features: simultaneous multi-user editing tracked in Revision History. Nothing describes comments, mentions or thread resolution, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email
